gloss: pain and pleasure; hardship and joy

definitions.gloss: pain and pleasure; hardship and joy
definitions.explanation: The experiences of suffering and happiness; the ups and downs of life.

examples.japanese: {苦楽|くらく}を{共|とも}にする。
examples.english: To share joys and sorrows together.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}には{苦楽|くらく}がある。
examples.english: Life has both hardships and joys.

examples.japanese: {苦楽|くらく}を{経験|けいけん}して{人|ひと}は{成長|せいちょう}する。
examples.english: People grow through experiencing both hardship and joy.

notes:
{苦楽|くらく} combines {苦|く} (pain, suffering) and {楽|らく} (pleasure, ease). It represents the full range of life experiences.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {苦楽|くらく}を{共|とも}にする: to share joys and sorrows
- {苦楽|くらく}を{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う: to share in each other's joys and sorrows
